correctness.rationale: Sign-parity characters split the full real/complex harmonic cubic space into d zonal lines, d standard (d-2)-dimensional transverse sectors and C(d,3) squarefree lines. Exact orbit and sphere moments yield all three rational eigenvalues; exhaustive dimensions add to C(d+2,3)-d; exact Gram testing covers 33 (d,k) pairs and direct enumeration eight further instances. All-dimensional proof is symbolic, not extrapolated from tests. k=3..d-1 positivity and the d=3k-2 blind subspace follow directly.

value.rationale: Gives a natural complete sharp frame-spectrum classification in all dimensions of sparse sphere sampling nodes; not merely a moment check. The 5-design equation yields a non-obvious catastrophic d-dimensional loss for *pure cubic* sampling with many more nodes than harmonic dimensions (e.g. 280 versus 77, rank 70), clarifying why low-strength integration accuracy does not imply stable higher-degree harmonic recovery. Exact min/max eigenvalues quantify observability and guide sampling choices.
